day_shape: 62 items: IRGC says a supertanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, explosions reported at Riyadh airport with Kuwait cancelling flights, Jerusalem Post cites report of US pressing Israel for solo Iran strike, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: IRGC Navy public relations said a supertanker illegally carrying crude oil exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine while attempting to exit the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route. The Jerusalem Post flagged the IRGC account as a developing story citing Iranian state media.

threads.label: Riyadh explosions and airport warning
threads.summary: Defa Press cited Arab sources reporting multiple explosions in Riyadh and at Riyadh airport, and said Kuwait cancelled flights to Saudi Arabia following an Ansarullah missile attack. IRIB reported the US mission in Saudi Arabia advised American citizens to avoid Riyadh airport and surrounding areas.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and missile capacity reporting
threads.summary: Iran International reported new construction at an Iranian compound previously struck by Israel, citing a Washington-based research institute linking the site to nuclear weapons research. The Jerusalem Post cited Western intelligence assessments that Iran has preserved key weapons factories and continues missile production.

threads.label: US-Israel Iran strike reporting and war costs
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited a Maariv report that the US pressed Israel over the past two weeks to conduct a solo strike operation against Iran, and flagged a CRS report detailing 81 US aircraft damaged or destroyed in the Iran war. Defa Press cited a Washington Post piece describing the war with Iran as a quagmire for America.

threads.label: Iran oil revenue and power shortfall
threads.summary: Iran International cited Kpler's head of crude analysis saying Iranian oil and condensate export revenue could dry up by mid-December if the US blockade holds. A separate Iran International report said Iran is seeking more electricity from Turkey and Turkmenistan as war damage leaves thousands of megawatts offline.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and Lebanon interception
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck Nukhba operatives in Gaza City, naming Muad Mazen Hamza Hassouna, Muhammad Riyad Khader Arahim and Islamic Jihad anti-tank commander Muhammad Walid Saadi Nakhala, and separately eliminated Muhammad Abu Shalouf and Musa Atef Musa Abu Dan. The Jerusalem Post reported the IDF fired an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran internal security and judiciary
threads.summary: Defa Press reported President Pezeshkian's statement on terrorist acts and an interior ministry delegation sent to Sistan and Baluchestan after the martyrdom of provincial police deputy Nosrat Eftekhari, while Khamenei issued an appreciation message to Faraja forces. Iran International reported the jailed wife of a recently executed protester is being pressured to deny their marriage.

events.title_en: UN special rapporteur: Israel has used the equivalent of six nuclear bombs against Gaza
events.summary_en: UN special rapporteur: Israel has used the equivalent of six nuclear bombs against Gaza. Francesca Albanese, UN special rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories, described the humanitarian conditions in the Gaza Strip as very catastrophic. Albanese emphasised that Palestinians under siege are facing gradual death amid ongoing bombardments and destruction, spread of disease, malnutrition and lack of safe shelter. On the occasion of three years since the genocide war against Gaza, she said that the power of the bombs used in the attack on Gaza is equivalent to six nuclear bombs.

events.title_en: Illegal supertanker carrying crude oil burning in massive fire
events.summary_en: Illegal supertanker carrying crude oil burning in massive fire. Public relations of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Naval Force: A supertanker illegally carrying crude oil, which intended to leave the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route, was subjected to a severe explosion after striking a naval mine on the hazardous route. This supertanker, which had turned off its navigation and positioning systems, caught fire after striking a naval mine, burning in a massive blaze so intense it is clearly visible to coastal residents. A catastrophic fire is the fate of any tanker that seeks to undermine the security and laws of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.summary_en: Yemen: Tribes of Jabal al-Sharq and Khumis Bani al-Sahaqah and Bani al-Shia in Dhuran Ans declare general mobilisation. Tribes from the Jabal al-Sharq region and two Khumis of Bani al-Sahaqah and Bani al-Shia in Dhuran Ans district, located in Dhamar province, Yemen, announced on Saturday through an armed gathering that they had declared general mobilisation and readiness to confront the escalation of tensions. Participants in this gathering also condemned what they called crimes by the Saudi aggressor coalition against prisoners and wounded. Participants in this gathering once again expressed their support for Yemen's revolutionary leader and political and armed forces, and granted the authority to take necessary decisions to confront Saudi Arabia and forces affiliated with it

events.title_en: Washington Post: War with Iran has become a quagmire for America
events.summary_en: Washington Post: War with Iran has become a quagmire for America. The Washington Post wrote that whilst some Trump supporters claim American victory in war with Iran, the heavy military and economic costs of this conflict and the lack of a clear vision for its end present a different account of the state of the war. According to this newspaper, the war has become a quagmire for America; a conflict whose costs continue but Washington still has no clear objective for continuing it. As long as Trump does not make a decisive decision about the final course of the war, America will remain trapped in this impasse.

events.title_en: Araghchi: Iran resolutely defends its national interests and security
events.summary_en: Araghchi: Iran resolutely defends its national interests and security. The foreign minister in a meeting with his Armenian counterpart said: The Islamic Republic of Iran has resolutely defended and will defend its national interests and security, and at the same time has never hesitated in using diplomatic means to prevent escalation of tensions. Araghchi, explaining the Islamic Republic of Iran's positions on the importance of peace and stability in the Caucasus, expressed satisfaction with the continued positive process of interactions and relations between the Republic of Armenia and the Republic of Azerbaijan and Iran's readiness for the continuation of dialogue and multilateral cooperation including within the 3+3 framework to help stabilise the peace process and strengthen regional relations and cooperation

events.title_en: A delegation dispatched to investigate terrorist act in Sistan and Baluchestan
events.summary_en: A delegation dispatched to investigate terrorist act in Sistan and Baluchestan. The interior minister, following terrorist incidents in Sistan and Baluchestan and the martyrdom of Nosrat Eftekhari, deputy for cultural and social affairs of the provincial police command, in a message dispatched a delegation to the province to investigate the terrorist act. The chair of the National Security Council also emphasised to the dispatched delegation that in coordination with judicial and security authorities, those responsible for and perpetrators of the crime be identified and face justice for their actions.
